correctness.rationale: Kihara's Definition 2.6 right-to-left hierarchy recursion, with adjacent duplicate ordinary E/A quantifiers contracted, yields exactly 61 normalized Sigma_4 and 61 normalized Pi_4 patterns through length 7. The length-8 normalized level<=4 enumeration is empty and prepending never lowers level, proving the finite cutoff. The absorption rewrite (two infinite-quantifier expansions, ordinary contraction and arbitrary insertion) has a descendant/subsequence normal form. Independent generation of the complete 61x61 mutual absorption relations gives exactly 37 classes on each side (class sizes 1,2,4,8); the source's Sigma_3 sanity count 17 matches. Observation 2.22 gives an implication to di-many-one reducibility and hence upper bounds N_m and N_dm<=37. Crucially distinct absorption classes may still be semantically equivalent; NO equality or full semantic fourth-level classification is claimed.
residual_risks: An equivalent absorption quotient may be known in unpublished or unindexed notes.
The converse of absorption-implies-reducibility is not shown; N_m and N_dm can be strictly smaller than 37.
The rewrite-normal-form descendant lemma is analytic and is not replaced by finite checking; its assumptions are specific to Kihara expansions and arbitrary insertion.
